Beat 5: Anchoring The Avengers as Natasha Romanoff while earning double Oscar nods for Marriage Story and Jojo Rabbit made history.

Beat 6: Fighting a fierce legal battle against studio streaming releases, she stood up for actors' box-office contracts.

Beat 7: Making her directorial debut and winning a Tony Award, her fearless versatility leads modern cinema.

posts.comment:
**The secret behind cinema's highest-grossing star:**
• Has a fraternal twin brother named Hunter who appeared alongside her in Manny & Lo.
• Became only the twelfth actor in history to earn two Oscar nominations in one year for Marriage Story and Jojo Rabbit.
• Won the Tony Award for Best Featured Actress in a Play for A View from the Bridge.

Which Scarlett Johansson role is untouchable: Nicole in Marriage Story or Charlotte in Lost in Translation?
posts.reel_script: Before becoming one of the highest-grossing box-office stars in cinema history and earning two Academy Award nominations in a single year, a young girl in Manhattan was repeatedly rejected by casting directors who thought her raspy voice sounded like a cold. • Worked as a bartender in Los Angeles for nearly nine years while auditioning hundreds of times before You Can Count on Me.

Beat 5: Proving her dazzling comedic genius in Trading Places, A Fish Called Wanda, True Lies, and Freaky Friday.

Beat 6: Quietly overcoming a secret decade-long painkiller addiction in the nineties, she celebrated over twenty-five years of sobriety.

Beat 7: Winning her first Oscar at sixty-four for Everything Everywhere All at Once and an Emmy for The Bear, she is unstoppable.

Beat 8: **Was Halloween, True Lies, or Everything Everywhere All at Once Jamie Lee Curtis's finest hour?**
posts.comment:
**The secret behind cinema's unstoppable Scream Queen:**
• Dropped out of the University of the Pacific after one semester studying law to pursue acting.
• Won a BAFTA, Golden Globes, an Emmy for The Bear, and an Oscar for Everything Everywhere All at Once.
• Celebrated more than twenty-five years of sobriety after privately overcoming prescription painkiller addiction.

Which Jamie Lee Curtis classic do you love most: Halloween, True Lies, or Freaky Friday?
posts.reel_script: Before winning her first Academy Award at sixty-four and an Emmy Award for The Bear, a college dropout in California stepped onto a low-budget horror set at age nineteen and changed cinema forever as Laurie Strode.
